Get group-level linear functions from a fitted model

Source: R/prolfqua-deprecated.R
linfct_from_model.Rd

Get group-level linear functions from a fitted model

Usage

linfct_from_model(m, as_list = TRUE)

Arguments

m

linear model

as_list

if TRUE, return the factor and interaction matrices as a list; if FALSE, as one matrix

Value

if as_list = TRUE, a list with the matrices linfct_factors (one row per factor level) and linfct_interactions (one row per observed factor combination), each with one column per model coefficient; otherwise the two matrices bound by rows into a single matrix

Details

The fitted model supplies its coefficient names and observed categorical factor combinations. Each combination is expressed as weights on the fitted coefficients; weights for an individual factor level are averaged equally over the observed combinations containing that level. Thus linfct_factors describes marginal factor-level means and linfct_interactions describes cell means. With treatment coding, a reference-level mean includes the intercept; a non-reference mean also includes its treatment coefficient. The Under the hood article shows a complete ~ A * B example. These helpers assume categorical predictors and the usual intercept-based coding; they are not a general marginal-means implementation for continuous predictors or arbitrary coding.

Note

Deprecated in prolfqua 1.9.5; use Contrasts$get_linfct(). See prolfqua-deprecated.
